svg.title: Alexandre Dulaunoy — work and interests over time
svg.desc: Selected milestones: hotp-js and Forban in 2009–2011; cve-search, AIL, MISP taxonomy work and misp-standard.org in 2012–2019; hashlookup, RansomLook and Vulnerability-Lookup in 2020–2024; GCVE, The Art of Pivoting and RIFP in 2025–2026. Overlapping themes include threat intelligence, vulnerability disclosure, forensics, Internet infrastructure, open standards, research, teaching and community work. Wider interests include computer science, information representation, photography, art, writing, reading, gardening, biology and ecological systems. Periods group milestones and do not imply project start or end dates.
